summary: Pomdoctor Limited filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt, on October 6, 2026, of a Nasdaq Listing Qualifications staff determination letter finding non-compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule after ADSs closed below $1.00 for 30 consecutive business days (August 24–October 5, 2026). Because the company effected a 1-for-18 reverse stock split on June 22, 2026, it is ineligible for the standard 180-day cure period. Absent a timely hearing request by October 13, 2026, trading suspends at the October 15 open, followed by a Form 25-NSE. The company intends to appeal. Watch the Panel outcome and any renewed bid-price support.
